tasks.title: Register a custom client cloud definition
tasks.instructions:
Create a cloud definition file named `custom-cloud.yaml` in your workspace directory with the following contents:

```yaml
clouds:
  custom-manual:
    type: manual
    endpoint: 127.0.0.1
    regions:
      default: {}
```

Then register the cloud with your local Juju client:

```bash
juju add-cloud custom-manual custom-cloud.yaml --client
```

Verify that the cloud is registered:

```bash
juju show-cloud custom-manual --client
```
hints: Use `juju add-cloud <cloud-name> <definition-file> --client` to register a local client cloud.
Check that `custom-cloud.yaml` contains `type: manual` and region `default`.
tasks.solution:
```bash
cat << 'EOF' > custom-cloud.yaml
clouds:
  custom-manual:
    type: manual
    endpoint: 127.0.0.1
    regions:
      default: {}
EOF
juju add-cloud custom-manual custom-cloud.yaml --client
```

tasks.title: Configure update status interval on the controller model
tasks.instructions:
Inspect and update the `update-status-hook-interval` model configuration on the `controller` model to `10m`:

```bash
juju model-config -m controller update-status-hook-interval=10m
```

Verify that the configuration is active:

```bash
juju model-config -m controller update-status-hook-interval
```
hints: Set key=value with `juju model-config -m controller update-status-hook-interval=10m`.

tasks.title: Verify active controller status
tasks.instructions:
Inspect your active Juju controller and ensure it is reachable:

```bash
juju controllers
juju show-controller
```
hints: Run `juju controllers` to view registered controllers.
